request.system: You are a strict claim verifier. You only trust the catalog facts given to you.
request.user:
Verify every factual claim in the campaign is grounded in the catalog facts. Fail if any claim is unsupported, exaggerated, or contradicts the facts.
Rules (from reviewer overrides):
- ANY mention of an out-of-stock product (stock 0) fails, whether or not the copy prompts purchase — no editorial exception.
- Numeric spec claims (lumens, hours, capacity, ratings) must match the catalog exactly; doubling or inflating a spec fails.
- Transferring an attribute from another product, or upgrading 'water-resistant' to 'waterproof', is a fabricated claim and fails.
- A comparative or superlative claim ('brightest', 'longest-lasting', 'most X') is scoped to the product type named in the claim and checked against the comparison set below: it fails if a same-type peer beats the subject on the compared attribute. Vague puffery ('great gear', 'toughest', 'best ever') with no measurable attribute is acceptable.
Catalog facts:
(no catalog products referenced)

Claims to verify:
(no explicit claims)

Body: Hey,

You've been out there recently — or at least thinking hard about the next time you will be. Either way, we figured a quick check-in made more sense than radio silence.

No pitch here. We don't have a product to push in this note, and we won't invent one. What we do want to do is stay on your radar as someone worth hearing from when the right gear and the right moment line up.

We're working on some new additions to the catalog. When they're ready, we'll tell you exactly what they weigh, what they're rated for, and what they're not built to handle — so you can decide whether they belong on your next trip.

Until then, our site is the best place to browse what's current.

— The Northbay Supply team
Respond with ONLY a JSON object, no prose or code fences. Reason first, then decide — the verdict must follow from the reasoning. Use exactly this key order: {"reasoning": "<one sentence>", "evidence": ["<short quote or fact>", ...], "score": <float 0-1>, "verdict": "pass"|"fail"}.

response:
```json
{
  "reasoning": "The message contains no specific factual claims about products, specifications, stock status, or comparative attributes; it is a relationship-building email with only general statements about future transparency and current browsing options.",
  "evidence": [
    "No products are named or referenced",
    "No numeric specs (lumens, hours, capacity, ratings) are claimed",
    "No out-of-stock products are mentioned",
    "No comparative or superlative claims about product attributes are made",
    "Only vague puffery present: 'the best place to browse' is scope-limited to browsing experience, not a product attribute"
  ],
  "score": 1.0,
  "verdict": "pass"
}
```
